note: Held-out data only. Tool/supplier/material IDs are simulated; WM-811K and SECOM come from different fabs and are paired for the demo.

scenarios.name: Lot A — recurring Edge-Ring
scenarios.story: A real test lot where many wafers show Edge-Ring. Expect a LOT pattern once ≥3 are seen.

scenarios.name: Lot B — same pattern, same tool
scenarios.story: A different real lot with Edge-Ring, routed (simulated) through the SAME etch tool as Lot A. Run after Lot A: expect a TOOL pattern — two lots, one tool.

scenarios.name: Lot C — Random defects: two lots, two tools, one material lot
scenarios.story: Two different real lots with scattered (Random) failures, run (simulated) on two different CVD tools but cut from the SAME material lot. Expect a MATERIAL pattern: lot and tool both vary, only the material is shared.
